bullets.title: PANW: Lawsuit alleging accounting fraud filed by former executive
bullets.body: A former Palo Alto Networks executive has filed a lawsuit alleging accounting fraud at the company. No further financial details or magnitudes were provided in the source, but the allegation is a potential headline risk for the stock.

bullets.title: META: Dutch court halts smart glasses sales in Netherlands on privacy grounds
bullets.body: A Dutch consumer rights group obtained a court order halting Meta smart glasses sales in the Netherlands due to privacy concerns. This is a regulatory/legal overhang for Meta's hardware segment in the EU, though the Netherlands market is small relative to global scale.

bullets.title: ARM: Morgan Stanley flags growing conviction in AI ramp at European TMT Conference
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley's European TMT Conference highlighted ARM Holdings as a name with growing conviction around AI ramp, with semiconductors and data center demand cited as among the biggest stock debates. The note flagged a disconnect between constructive corporate commentary and cautious investor positioning.
